notes: 2 sheets (Views A, B), both checked. Units: note 5 'UNITS: MILLIMETERS'. Notes 1-5 (sheet 1, text); note 4 'NON-RIGID PART. DIRECTLY-TOLERANCED DIMENSIONS AND TOLERANCES APPLY IN FREE STATE.' Dimension / frame text is geometry ('curves'). Every frame carries the free-state modifier (F) - not encoded, so no modifiers field: circularity 1.2(F) on 'Ø32 ±0.3 AVG (I.D.)', circular run-out 1.2(F) A B, profile 0.3(F) A B, flatness 0.3(F) on datum A. 'Ø63 ±0.5 AVG (O.D.)' and 'Ø32 ±0.3 AVG (I.D.)' are average diameters (AVG not encoded). '(197.9)' carries an arc symbol over the number - a reference arc length, recorded with nominal + reference only (no type). The 'B' with a section-line arrow at the right of sheet 1 is the section / view B indicator, not a datum; datum feature B is the symbol on the Ø32 extension line. Sheet 2: '2X R0.1 MAX' (radius, max only), '1.93 ±0.08'. tolerance.tightest = 2X R1.5 ±0.04 (band 0.08). Naming rule used for Ø callouts: a callout with an 'nX' count, THRU / depth, or an uppercase (hole) fit is recorded as hole.diameter {diameter, count, upper, lower}; any other Ø size is a dimension {type:'diameter'}. Tolerances are recorded as signed deviations upper/lower; limit dimensions as max/min. GD&T: characteristic in words, datums = the datum letters in order (datum-reference modifiers not encoded), modifiers 'MMC' / 'LMC' = circled M / L after the tolerance value, diameterZone true only where Ø precedes the tolerance.
